-----------------------------------------------
---1. Sales Performance View

-- How many orders do we have?
-- How much did we sell?
-- What is the average order value?
-- What was the highest-value order?
-----------------------------------------------

CREATE VIEW gold.vw_SalesPerformance
AS
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT F.DimOrdersKey) AS TotalOrders,
    SUM(F.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity,
    SUM(F.TotalAmount) AS TotalSales,
    AVG(F.TotalAmount) AS AverageOrderValue,
    MIN(F.TotalAmount) AS MinimumOrderValue,
    MAX(F.TotalAmount) AS MaximumOrderValue
FROM gold.FactOrders AS F;



-----------------------------------------------
-- 2. Customer Sales 

-- Who are our top customers?
-- Which customers generate the most revenue?
-- How many orders does each customer make?
-----------------------------------------------
CREATE VIEW gold.vw_CustomerSales
AS
SELECT
    C.CustomerID,
    C.CustomerName,
    C.CustomerEmail,
    C.Domain,
    COUNT(DISTINCT F.DimOrdersKey) AS TotalOrders,
    SUM(F.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity,
    SUM(F.TotalAmount) AS TotalSales,
    AVG(F.TotalAmount) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM gold.FactOrders AS F
LEFT JOIN gold.DimCustomer AS C
    ON F.DimCustomerKey = C.DimCustomerKey
GROUP BY
    C.CustomerID,
    C.CustomerName,
    C.CustomerEmail,
    C.Domain;

-----------------------------------------------
-- 3. Product Performance View 

-- Which products generate the most revenue?
-- Which products have the highest quantity sold?
-- Which product category performs best?
-----------------------------------------------

CREATE VIEW gold.vw_ProductPerformance
AS
SELECT
    P.ProductID,
    P.ProductName,
    P.ProductCategory,
    COUNT(DISTINCT F.DimOrdersKey) AS TotalOrders,
    SUM(F.Quantity) AS TotalQuantitySold,
    SUM(F.TotalAmount) AS TotalSales,
    AVG(F.UnitPrice) AS AverageUnitPrice,
    AVG(F.TotalAmount) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM gold.FactOrders AS F
LEFT JOIN gold.DimProduct AS P
    ON F.DimProductKey = P.DimProductKey
GROUP BY
    P.ProductID,
    P.ProductName,
    P.ProductCategory;

-----------------------------------------------
-- 4. Geography Performance View 

-- Which products generate the most revenue?
-- Which products have the highest quantity sold?
-- Which product category performs best?
-----------------------------------------------

CREATE VIEW gold.vw_GeographyPerformance
AS
SELECT
    G.RegionID,
    G.Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT F.DimOrdersKey) AS TotalOrders,
    SUM(F.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity,
    SUM(F.TotalAmount) AS TotalSales,
    AVG(F.TotalAmount) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM gold.FactOrders AS F
LEFT JOIN gold.DimGeography AS G
    ON F.DimGeographyKey = G.DimGeographyKey
GROUP BY
    G.RegionID,
    G.Country;


SELECT *
FROM gold.vw_GeographyPerformance
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC;


-----------------------------------------------
-- 5. Product Category Performance View
-----------------------------------------------

CREATE VIEW gold.vw_CategoryPerformance
AS
SELECT
    P.ProductCategory,
    COUNT(DISTINCT F.DimOrdersKey) AS TotalOrders,
    SUM(F.Quantity) AS TotalQuantitySold,
    SUM(F.TotalAmount) AS TotalSales,
    AVG(F.UnitPrice) AS AverageUnitPrice
FROM gold.FactOrders AS F
LEFT JOIN gold.DimProduct AS P
    ON F.DimProductKey = P.DimProductKey
GROUP BY
    P.ProductCategory;


SELECT *
FROM gold.vw_CategoryPerformance
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC;


-----------------------------------------------
-- 6. Customer Domain Performance
-----------------------------------------------

CREATE VIEW gold.vw_DomainPerformance
AS
SELECT
    C.Domain,
    COUNT(DISTINCT C.CustomerID) AS TotalCustomers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT F.DimOrdersKey) AS TotalOrders,
    SUM(F.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity,
    SUM(F.TotalAmount) AS TotalSales,
    AVG(F.TotalAmount) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM gold.FactOrders AS F
LEFT JOIN gold.DimCustomer AS C
    ON F.DimCustomerKey = C.DimCustomerKey
GROUP BY
    C.Domain;
